authority: CEO R330 Gate 5 — P-22 hardened with full navigation model
R329_simplification_acknowledged: R329 P-22 used Stokes drag only. Force margin was reported as 116 million× (numerically correct but scientifically meaningless — Stokes drag at 0.1mm/s is negligible). The actual navigation problem includes tissue contact, friction, bending, buckling, and control stability.

tissue_contact_force.mechanism: Catheter must push against brain tissue to navigate
tissue_contact_force.comparison_to_actuation: Actuation force 3.2 N >> contact force 0.1 N. Actuation is sufficient for tissue displacement.

bending_stiffness.comparison_to_actuation: Actuation torque (0.064 Nm) > bending moment (0.0000314 Nm). Sufficient.

buckling.comparison_to_actuation: Actuation force 3.2 N >> buckling load 0.039 N. The catheter WILL buckle before reaching the actuation force limit. This means the actuation force cannot be fully applied to navigation — the catheter bends rather than pushes.
buckling.finding: BUCKLING IS THE BOTTLENECK. The SMP force (3.2 N) exceeds the Euler buckling load (0.039 N) by 82x. The catheter will buckle, not navigate. The effective navigation force is limited by buckling, not by SMP stress.
buckling.effective_margin_vs_drag: 0.039 N vs 2.76e-8 N drag = 1.4 million × (still huge, but the limiting factor changed from Stokes drag to buckling)

control_stability.finding: Navigation requires closed-loop control (sensor → processor → actuator). No control model exists. This is a MAJOR gap — autonomous navigation without control analysis is just actuation, not navigation.
control_stability.status: NOT MODELED. This is the real bottleneck for P-22.

response_time.finding: SMP actuation is slow (5-30s per step). Navigation over 10mm would take 10-60 minutes. Clinically acceptable (not emergency), but slow.

honest_assessment.label: COMPUTATIONALLY SUPPORTED (actuation hypothesis). Buckling limits effective force. Control stability NOT modeled — this is the real navigation bottleneck. Not 'autonomous catheter navigation technology.'
honest_assessment.remaining_bottleneck: 1. Control stability model (closed-loop navigation). 2. Buckling mitigation (multi-segment articulation). 3. Tissue safety (navigation force vs tissue damage threshold).
honest_assessment.buyer_action: COMMISSION TEST — computational: closed-loop control model + buckling analysis. Then bench: SMP segment in tissue phantom.
